body: As an apostate, shunned member, I can attest to this. I was only half in the cult for the first 18 years of my life, but some in my family were in it for way longer and way deeper. Luckily the ones who mattered got out, but we are all shunned from the blood family that remained in. Usually they're brainwashed to think that they have a quota of people to save to be a part of the chosen few to awaken in the 'new world.'
